senses.gloss: m. (adaptation of flagellum, φραγέλλιον; cmp. פַּרְכִּיל) whip, scourge; young vine shoot.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 32">Lev. R. s. 32</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Zechariah 13:6">Zech. XIII, 6</cite>) <he>מה לך לוקה בפ׳ וכ׳</he> why art thou whipped with the scourge? Because I made a Succah; Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod., s. 6 <he>מה לך לוקה מאה פ׳</he> (not <he>מאפ׳</he>) why art thou to get a hundred lashes?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 292:2">Yalk. Ex. 292</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 581">Yalk. Zech. 581</cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 12">Midr. Till. to Ps. XII</cite>, end <he>מה לך יוצא לידקר בפוראגון</he> (ed. Bub. <he>מה לך לוקה בפרוגין</he>, corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 4:4">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IV, 4</cite> <he>פ׳ שעשה בראשו וכ׳</he> a whip to the top of which a knob is attached to strike with it.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 5:1:5">Y. B. Bath. V, beg. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>אם היה עשוי כמין פ׳</he> (not <cite ref="I00704"><he>טרגול</he></cite>) if the young shoot of the olive tree has the shape of a vine shoot (hanging down and knotted).
